title: In-Context Source and Channel Coding
abstract: arXiv:2601.10267v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Separate Source-Channel Coding (SSCC) remains attractive for text transmission due to its modularity and compatibility with mature entropy coders and powerful channel codes. However, SSCC often suffers from a pronounced cliff effect in low Signal-to-Noise Ratio (SNR) regimes, where residual bit errors after channel decoding can catastrophically break lossless source decoding, especially for Arithmetic Coding (AC) driven by Large Language Models (LLMs). This paper proposes a receiver-side In-Context Decoding (ICD) framework that enhances SSCC robustness without modifying the transmitter. ICD leverages an Error Correction Code Transformer (ECCT) to obtain bit-wise reliability for the decoded information bits. translated_title: 上下文中的信源与信道编码
translated_abstract: 摘要：arXiv:2601.10267v2 公告类型：替换 摘要：分离式信源-信道编码（SSCC）因其模块化以及与成熟熵编码器和强大信道编码的兼容性，在文本传输中仍然具有吸引力。然而，SSCC在低信噪比（SNR）区域常常遭受明显的悬崖效应，其中信道解码后的残余比特错误可能灾难性地破坏无损信源解码，尤其是对于由大型语言模型（LLM）驱动的算术编码（AC）。本文提出了一种接收端上下文解码（ICD）框架，在不修改发射机的情况下增强SSCC的鲁棒性。ICD利用纠错码变换器（ECCT）获得解码信息比特的逐位可靠性。基于上下文一致的比特流，ICD通过可靠性引导的比特翻转构建一个置信度排序的候选池，采样一个紧凑但多样化的候选子集，并应用基于LLM的算术解码器来输出最终结果。
tldr: 本文提出了一种接收端上下文解码框架，利用纠错码变换器和可靠性引导的候选采样，在不改变发射机的情况下显著提升分离式信源-信道编码在低信噪比下的鲁棒性，克服了悬崖效应。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a receiver-side in-context decoding framework that leverages an error correction code transformer and reliability-guided candidate sampling to significantly enhance the robustness of separate source-channel coding at low SNR without modifying the transmitter, overcoming the cliff effect.
